newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Premier yr headline EPS up, div rises.
newsitem.headline: Premier yr headline EPS up, div rises.

text.p: Analysts polled by Reuters forecast headline earnings rising to between 38.5 cents and 40 cents a share with consensus at 39.4. They expected the dividend to come in a range of 14.2 to 17.0 cents with consensus at 15.4.
Full name: The Premier Group Ltd

NOTE - Directors said that the comparative figures for the year ended April 30, 1996 had been restated to reflect a number of moves including the merger of unit Premier Pharmaceuticals Ltd with Adcock Ingram Ltd and the sale of The Clicks Group.

They said they would award capitalisation shares to shareholders registered in the firm's books on July 18. The number of shares shareholders would receive would be determined by the ratio that 11.5 cents multiplied by 1.06 bears to the issue price. This price was defined as the weighted average traded price of shares on the Johannesburg Stock exchange for the four days ending August 14.
